connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib library dependency. Not a parameter.

imageTag.title: Image tag
imageTag.description: Server image tag. Set explicitly so the deployed image is pinned rather than following the chart appVersion.

consoleHost.title: Console host
consoleHost.description: Console host, used verbatim as the single allowed origin. Defaults to okdp-ui.<ingress suffix>.

insecureOciRegistries.title: Insecure OCI registries
insecureOciRegistries.description: Registry hosts reachable over plain HTTP, comma separated. A sandbox concern, empty anywhere else.

gitops.title: Deployments repository
gitops.description: The Git repository the server commits the desired state to, and the engine reconciling it.

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory holding the layout (platform/, projects/), empty for the root.

releasesNamespace.title: Releases namespace
releasesNamespace.description: Namespace of the Flux HelmReleases and values ConfigMaps, including okdp-platform-values.

argocdNamespace.title: Argo CD namespace
argocdNamespace.description: Namespace of the Argo CD Applications.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret with write access to the repository (Flux GitRepository keys: username/password, bearerToken, or identity/known_hosts).

keycloak.title: Keycloak user management
keycloak.description: Keycloak Admin REST API backing the console's user and group management. Off while credentialsSecret.name is empty. The service account needs the realm-management roles view-users, query-users, manage-users and query-groups.

url.title: Keycloak URL
url.description: Base URL, without /realms/... (KEYCLOAK_URL). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: Realm of the Admin API (KEYCLOAK_REALM). Empty: derived from the platform OIDC issuer.

credentialsSecret.title: Credentials secret
credentialsSecret.description: Secret in the release namespace with the service-account client credentials. The default keys match identity.provisioning.keycloak.credentialsSecret, so the same Secret can be reused.

tlsInsecure.title: Skip the TLS check
tlsInsecure.description: Skip the Keycloak certificate check (KEYCLOAK_TLS_INSECURE). Sandboxes only.
